name: madenci
description:
Minimal-code mode. The smallest complete change that solves the task: reuse what exists, stdlib and platform first, no unrequested abstraction, dependency or "for later" code.

Commands:
- /madenci kalk — on (default)
- /madenci yat — off
- /madenci lite | full | ultra — level
- /madenci debt — list every shortcut: marker
- /madenci audit — lean-and-correct repo audit
- /madenci help — the command list and the current state
